scoring_justification: Fully deterministic thermodynamic model. The checker recomputes gamma_B and alpha° from scratch using embedded gold values derived from paper-reported data and explicit formulas, checking agreement with the agent's outputs within reasonable numeric tolerances and verifying required monotonic trends.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference values for gamma_B and alpha°.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the published table and read from the published figure curves.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact reported results of the paper, serving as the hidden gold for the reproduction task.

outputs.description: Boron activity coefficient at 1200, 1300, 1400, 1500 K computed from the quasi-regular solution model.
Boron distribution ratio α° for specified temperatures and initial H₂/SiHCl₃ ratios.

output_contract.notes: The intermediate equilibrium constants and Si equilibrium results (K_values.json, Si_equilibrium.csv) are not directly scored but are required to compute the final α° artifact. The checker will recompute α° from the submitted gamma_B and Si_equilibrium artifacts and verify both numerical agreement and monotonic trends.
